story_type: cockpit view of a C-130 dropping fire retardant on a major wildfire
hook: Inside a C-130 laying retardant on the Palisades Fire.
narration: This cargo plane was dumping fire retardant on the Palisades Fire.
It was January eleventh, 2025, in the mountains above Pacific Palisades, California.
The C-130J belongs to the California Air National Guard's 146th Airlift Wing.
It carries a MAFFS unit, a tank that rolls into the cargo hold and blasts retardant out a side door with compressed air.
The pilots fly low over the ridges to lay it down in one long line.
[short pause] Retardant coats the brush ahead of the flames, so the fire slows when it gets there.
outcome: The crew laid its line of fire retardant on the Palisades Fire.
title: Palisades Fire retardant drop, cockpit
